Leah: Heads up 1 - Acme Corp on-prem invoice shows platform fee omitted after support tier bump. marked as billing dispute.
Diego: which invoice #? I can pull it.
Leah: INV-2026-099 (uploaded to admin). They accepted Premium Support in amendment ACME-AMEND-03 effective 2026-01-10.
Samir: I see invoice: support line is Premium, usage true-up included, platform_fee = $0. expected ~$1,200 prorated.
Diego: billing-bot says migration flag missed for platform_fee when amendment processed. classic config drift.
billing-bot: invoice.created INV-2026-099 at 1773008001 by Samir.
Samir: Plan: regen invoice with proration, mark original as cancelled, add footnote referencing amendment and PO #PO-9012.
Leah: Please include the signed amendment PDF and the customer's PO in the email. avoid surprise: one-liner explainer for the customer.
Diego: Draft message suggestion: ```Hi Acme team 1, we've reissued corrected invoice INV-2026-099R to reflect prorated platform fee per amendment ACME-AMEND-03 (effective 2026-01-10). Usage true-up unchanged. Invoice supersedes previous copy. Thanks, Diego (Billing Ops)```
Samir: I'll attach amendment + PO and route through finance approvals queue (FA-3345) before sending.
Leah: Also tag RevOps so revenue forecast updates.
revops-bot: ticket REVOPS-1154 created and linked to INV-2026-099R.
Diego: ETA on reissue after approval?
Samir: ~90 minutes after approval. I've queued the regen.
Leah: Can CS prep a short Q&A in case Acme asks about proration math? one slide or bullet points.
Diego: good call, @Samir can you include the breakdown lines in the email body: dedicated capacity, support (premium proration), usage true-up, platform fee proration.
Samir: will do. I'll update thread when INV-2026-099R is sent and post the admin invoice link. :white_check_mark:
